blocks.title: Compliance? Covered with confidence.
blocks.intro: We help you to achieve and retain your licence to operate.

elements.text: We started out as a marine classification society.

elements.html: Today, we’re one of the world’s leading providers of engineering and technology-centric professional services – improving safety and increasing the performance of critical infrastructures for clients in over 75 countries worldwide. Operating both at a global level and with local expertise, we are accredited to certify that your products and services meet over 700 external or internal standards, schemes, rules, codes or directives.
Our independence means that we provide reliable, impartial and informed advice that you can trust, free from compromise, free from prejudice.
